behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 84, no. 9]

column4: And I responded, saying, “Yes sir, I will go for study/to school.”
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 84, no. 10]
behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 84, no. 11]

column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 85, no. 12]

column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 85, no. 13]

column3: et̪e aiŋ məɾeiŋ pɐɖʰav-əɡena mɐ̆ɳăŋə̆ŋi t̪ɐhale iŋ sɐt̪vi pas ke-hai aɽaʔ-ɡot̪e
column4: and because of my family condition, I left my studies after my 7th standard.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 85, no. 14]

column3: t̪ɐ̆ha pɐrɪjodʒena hodʒeea hăi kɐt̪ət̪era ki koji patʃvi pɐɖʰa-likʰa koɽva leɡɪd̪ɐnɪja
column4: Then a government (official) came and was asking/searching for a Korwa fellow who has passed 5th standard.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 85, no. 15]

column3: d̪o ale koɽvaku kat̪ət̪era hă mi hoɽɨ ɪd̪anija d̪o ɪŋ kud̪aɖiŋɡ-popoɖa kʰet̪re
column4: Then our Korwa-people said, “Yes, there is one man.” At that time I was working in the field (farming).
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 85, no. 16]

column3: hasɪŋ d̪oharo ndʰumnɐ d̪ʰokʰoɖiŋ hasɪŋ d̪ohar-t̪era pɐɽujanɪŋɪŋ uɡʰarapasjanɪŋ
column4: I was digging the soil, full of sweating, and was becoming so tired.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 85, no. 17]

column3: naː tɐnteŋku nəɡ am d̪o saheb pura-kar-me ne-ɔkɐrai saheb tʃuameraɡoi
column4: After that somebody came and told me that a sir (government official) is calling you.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 85, no. 18]

column3: bɪŋ seneɖ mi bor mi dʒuaɖ pɐrnam saheb pɐrnam pɐrnam
column4: Then I went with one (part) fear and one (part) strength, greeting him.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 86, no. 19]

column3: mɐnɐ kɐt̪at̪era ket̪e atʃʰa am-me pɐɖʰa lɪkʰar kija ʔ d̪o ɪŋ kɐt̪atera hă saheb pɐɖʰau kɪjĕ
column4: He asked me whether I have studied, then I told him, “Yes sir, I have studied.”
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 86, no. 20]

column3: t̪umɪn pɐɖʰau kare păttʃvɪn pas kɐra ʔ hă saheb pătʃvi d̪ɪn pas kɐra t̪ele sat̪vihɪm pas kɐra aʈʰvivɪm pas kɐra ʔ atʰvivɪm d̪uɖuʔu nad̪o iŋ ɐppaŋɡ ɡoidʒena et̪e aiŋ oɽarɐ kʰet̪ibari kɐrbet̪a kɐhi-kɐhi nɐi pɐɖʰa veɡʰɐn
column4: How many years did you study? Did you pass 5th standard? Yes sir, I have passed 7th standard. Also did you pass 8th? I sat in/was in 8th standard but my father died so I am working in my house (farming), therefore not able to study.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 86, no. 21]

column3: ʃad̪i bihă hojaena ʔ hă hojaena
column4: Then did marriage happen? Yes, it has happened.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 86, no. 22]

column3: atʃʰa am mi kam me karve t̪a ʔ tʃɪla kam saheb ʔ am nɔkri lɐɡad̪aro ʔ iŋ t̪ɐɡɡere saheb nuiŋɡ nɔkri bainɪŋ mɪnihoɽɨ ɪd̪e iŋ oɽaʔre
column4: Then he asked will/can you do one work. What work sir? Then he told I will register you for service and I told no sir because I am alone in my home.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 86, no. 23]

column4: Then he said, “No, you have to do the service (job).”
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 86, no. 24]

column3: ɪŋ ad̪es ɡoɖt̪iŋ am kʰud̪ kɐrekpaɖat̪a am ke saheb aɖese uɖuŋ ɔt̪eʔ
column4: “I will give this order and you will surely have to do the job,” he said.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 86, no. 25]

column3: iŋɡ seneɖ d̪o saheb ɪsɐre hă amra lɐɡave năm
column4: After the order/advice given by sir, I went to work as my name was registered for the job.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.2, p. 87, no. 26]

column3: iŋ pɐdʰɨvau ɲeu na pɐdʰɨt̪e pɐdʰɨt̪e naru kɐnjaku tʃʰapabɐtiɲu pʰinu iŋ kɐʰniki eraŋ tʃadina
column4: When I was studying, I was asked to search a girl for my marriage.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 87, no. 1]

column3: d̪o pʰir dʒɐbɐr dʒɐst̪ pʰiru iɲu kɐnjaku kɐɡvadiɲu
column4: However, though I was not willing, I still had to search a girl and marry her as my parents forced me to.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 87, no. 2]

column3: bʰɐɨ ɡʰaʈ pahar t̪ɛɲ senʔɡɐut̪ eda
column4: We went through the hills and mountains in search of a girl.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 87, no. 3]

column3: ehna le senkent̪e bʰeɨ kub bɐɖʰijã adʒɔm t̪ɛd lɛ̃ʔã tʰiɔ le piɔ t̪ɛd aː bʰɐr lɐɡa dera kɔvɐʔt lɛ̃ʔã
column4: And as we were enquiring, we saw a beautiful girl and proposed to her. They gave us nice hospitality with good food.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 87, no. 4]

column3: aŋɡa ena pʰir aŋɡa enreʰ kubid̪at̪ lea bit̪at̪ele
column4: Then next morning we took the bride and departed from there and we said goodbye to her family members.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 87, no. 5]

column3: pʰir veb ɡʰaʈ pahar pʰir bɐbatɐŋɡ ɡʰat par kɐrek d̪ɔhɔena
column4: We came back home crossing those two hills we had gone through.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 88, no. 6]

column3: veb sɐmɐsja pʰir aɽaʔre medʒena vah oɽaʔre medʒɨkent̪e leʔaː
column4: It was difficult, but when we reached home we were welcomed by the people in our house.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 88, no. 7]

column3: nauri naːre bɐɖʰiã pʰir nahinɖeku ɡaũriku dʒɐbɐr hɐt̪aɖɨt̪ɐa
column4: Many people from our village gathered, especially those who were invited.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 88, no. 8]

column3: dʒit̪na neuht̪a t̪atku men mɐtʰd̪ɔ pʰir henɐʰri bɐɖʰijãt̪e pʰir dʒɐʰn d̪ʰɐun t̪elju en dʒomena
column4: All of them, especially those who were invited, came and had nice food.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 88, no. 9]

column3: henɐuri riven dʒomen tse hoɽku d̪omarrku bulenaː na d̪ʰɐkmareku sɐsu enaɨɲd̪s t̪an̪d̪ɔ kɐ tʃit̪ɐn̪d̪ɔ
column4: People ate and drunk to their full and they danced after that.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 88, no. 10]

column3: baːd̪re pʰir ɲanaheɳɖe babar tɔŋɡ baːl bats-a bʰi hoja enu
column4: After my marriage now I have two children.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 88, no. 11]

column3: nehu kɐnar ɡʰt̪e dʒet̪e dʒemu t̪ɐna
column4: And somehow we are living quite well.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.3, p. 89, no. 12]

column4: When my parents were there (now they are no more) my siblings and I were very young or small.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 89, no. 1]

column3: vo sɐmɛjɛ me karibɐn t̪in ʃal kɐr ɐbɐst̪ʰa me dʒɐb mɔe hɔe t̪o æːr mor maɛ dʒo hɛ nuksan ho ɡehis
column4: My mother expired when I was around three years old.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 89, no. 2]
behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 89, no. 3]

column4: Our condition was very bad following our mother’s death.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 89, no. 4]

column4: Our father was very sick and along with him we also struggled from different sicknesses.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 89, no. 5]

column3: ŋu ɔkʰɐr bad̪ me pit̪adʒi kʰet̪i bari je sa.b tʃidʒ me bʰi bjɐst̪i
column4: After that, our father used to be busy working on the farm.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 90, no. 6]

column4: And he could not take any new job or another work.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 90, no. 7]

column3: ɔr kʰana bin bina me pɐresan uʈain
column4: He took many difficulties in working on the farm, sometimes even without food.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 90, no. 8]

column4: During those days there was no school in our village, neither was there any land facility for it.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 90, no. 9]

column4: It was then a teacher came to our village from Jashpur, his name was Tripathi.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 90, no. 10]

column4: He was sent by the government for teaching in our village.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 90, no. 11]

column3: ɔr jãha iskul t̪o nih kʰulɛ rehis lekin ek tʰo tʃʰɔtasa bɐraɳɖa d̪ɛhe hɔke
column4: However, there was no school but a veranda was given to him where he used to conduct the class.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 90, no. 12]

column3: tʃʰɔta sa bɐraɳɖa d̪ɛhe kɐr bad̪ me kɐriben pɐn̪d̪ira tʰo laɖka kɐriben jihã ekɐt̪rit̪ huin
column4: Initially around fifteen children gathered together for the class.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 91, no. 13]

column4: In response to this our father had a desire to send us for study and see us being educated.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 91, no. 14]

column3: ɔkʰɐr bad̪ me mastɐr lake iskɔ ɡurudʒi dʒaɔ leɖkɛ loɡ ko kahã kahã ɡʰum rɐhɛ̃ uskɔ kʰdʒ ke laɔ
column4: Our father requested the teacher to search and bring the children as they are wandering somewhere else.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 91, no. 15]

column3: t̪o hɐmloɡ naha hamɛ nahat̪ rɐhɛn ɔkʰɐr baːd̪ me mastɐr dʒo he kʰoidʒ ke le dʒai
column4: We were bathing in the river while the teacher came in search of us, he then took us to the class.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 91, no. 16]

column3: ɔur pitɐt̪ pitɐt̪ hɐmkɛ lɛke vuhã pɐɖʰais likʰaik kɐr iskul me biʈhair d̪ehɛ
column4: The teacher took us by beating and made us to sit in the class for study.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 91, no. 17]

column3: iskul me biʈʰare kɐr baːd̪ atʃʰa hɐmɛ d̪iltʃɐsbi lɛt̪ rɐhɛn dɐrsɛ
column4: We sat in the school and started studying with the fear of the teacher.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 91, no. 18]

column3: ɔr atʃʰa pɐɖʰais pɐɖʰai likʰai sɐb mastɐr sɐb lɐɖika dʒõ hɛ̃ jãhã iẽ atʃʰa kɐnːũũ dɐrsɛ pɐɖʰẽ hɛ mastɐr kɐr
column4: And all the children studied well in the fear of the teacher.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 92, no. 19]

column3: ar oh sɐmajĩ atʃʰa piʈai bʰi pɐre
column4: We learnt much discipline and it was very good.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 92, no. 20]

column3: hɐm dʒɐrasa bʰi ɡɐlt̪i t̪ɐmbakʰu ja biɖi ja koi bʰi aɡɐr koi nɐʃaː lɐɖka mɔn kʰaʰːɐt̪ rɐɛ̃ t̪o mastɐr kʰub piʈai kɐrɛ voʰ taim me
column4: The teacher used to beat us severely if we made any mistake or had a bad habit of smoking or chewing tobacco.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 92, no. 21]

column3: t̪o baːd̪ me lɐɖka mɔn bʰi rodʒ isi iskul ãbɛ̃
column4: All the children came to the school regularly.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 92, no. 22]

column3: iskul ãikɐ̃r baːd̪ me hamɐr ɡʰɐr dʒɐb mẽi pãtʃibi pas jãho hoi ɡẽʰ pas̃tʃibi pas hoi kɐr baːd̪ ɡjarhmi t̪ɐk hɐmɛ pɐɖʰɛn
column4: I also studied well; I passed fifth standard and continued my study till eleventh standard.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 92, no. 23]

column3: ɡjarhmĩ kɐr paʰ baːd̪ me nɔukri ɔʰen bɐhut̪ dʒjad a rɐhis sɐt̪t̪ɐr ekʰɐt̪t̪ɐr me
column4: There were lot of opportunities for jobs in 1970 to 1971, when I completed my 11th standard.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 92, no. 24]

column3: ɔuːr nɔukri kɐrbɐn mukabika bʰi milɐt̪ rɐhis
column4: And the facilities provided in the workplace were also good.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 93, no. 25]

column3: ɔr ɔkʰar baːd̪ me nɔukri hɐmɛ dʒob uãh tʃɛlɡen raiɡɐɖʰi
column4: I went to Raigarh for getting a job there.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 93, no. 26]

column3: raiɡɐɖʰi me kɐrɐt̪ rɐhɛn t̪o t̪urɐt̪ vo t̪o hɛi intɐrviu ɔːr t̪urɐt̪ hɔikɛ ɔkʰar baːd̪ me nɔukri mili dʒaɔt̪ rɐhis
column4: Those days it was easy to get a job; soon after my interview I got a job there.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 93, no. 27]

column3: t̪o baːd me de ɖeĩsɔ rupia kɐribɐn nɔukri kɐr kimɐt̪ rɐhi sohin
column4: I used to get one hundred and fifty rupees as my salary.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 93, no. 28]

column3: t̪o baːd̪ me d̪ɔ mɐhina t̪ɐk kɐrɛ̃ t̪o moke atʃʰa nĩh lɐɡis
column4: After working there for two months, I did not feel good about it.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 93, no. 29]

column3: uãhɔ kɐr ist̪ʰit̪i ɔur uãha kɐr mɐtʃʰɐɖɨ utʃʰɐɖi kɐr kaʈeː kɐr karɐɳ se meɨ bʰaiɡ d̪ɛ̃he
column4: There were so much of mosquito and I left the job because of mosquito bites.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 93, no. 30]

column3: baːd̪ me uãha se hɐm bʰaɡɛje ɔːr nɔukri nɛhi kijɛ
column4: I left the job and ran away from that place.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 93, no. 31]

column3: to̪ baːd̪ me kʰt̪i bari hɐmɛ ɡʰɐr me kɐrɛn
column4: After that, I started doing the farming work at home.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 94, no. 32]

column3: kʰet̪i bari kɐre kɐr baːd̪ me ab kutʃʰ protʃʰahɔn hɔisa
column4: Now our agricultural work is somewhat developed.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 94, no. 33]

column3: sasɐn t̪ɐrɐf se bʰi kutʃʰ bɐhut̪sa kʰaːd̪ ɔr d̪ɐbai ɔr je sɐb tʃidʒ dʒankari milis
column4: We get enough necessary information from the government. We also get much manure and medicine for the agricultural work.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 94, no. 34]

column3: ah d̪ʰire d̪ʰire sis dʒob pɐɖʰen likʰen husijar hɔɡɛin t̪o kʰet̪i ke atʃʰa kutʃʰ kaɳɖisɐn pɐr kɐren t̪o ab kutʃʰ sud̪ʰar hɔɡɛis
column4: Slowly with the new methods and good condition, we do the farming work. There is some improvement in it.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 94, no. 35]

column3: ɐb bɐtʃtʃamɔnla ɐb jãha me ɐtʃa pɐɖʰat̪ʰɐn likʰad̪ʰɐn
column4: Also our children are studying well now.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 94, no. 36]

column3: ɔːr pɐɖʰaɨk likʰaik kɐr baːd̪me je mɔn bʰi kutʃʰ ʃiktʃʰa prapt̪ɨ hɔɨɡɛin
column4: They are becoming educated by studying well.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 94, no. 37]

column3: ɔːr ɐbʰi kʰet̪i bari bɛɨse ʈʰik heɨ
column4: And in the same way, farming work is also going on well.
column8: behera2022korwakodaku[Appendix C.4, p. 95, no. 38]

column4: This is what we are up to.
